topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: I just found out the building is going condo. Everything I've known, everything that's been my little world, is flipping upside down, and I don't know how to catch myself. The landlord sent a letter, but the words are blurring together, the same way my future here is starting to blur. I can't afford a condo, and I don't know where I'll go. This place, my sanctuary, the one spot I called mine—what do I do now? The walls feel like they’re closing in, the quiet of the hall seems louder, more menacing. I need to find a way to stay, but the path ahead is dark and uncertain.
